reference_product: JMP / JMP Pro 19.2 reference baseline plus the public capability catalog retrieved 2026-10-21; not a claim of current-version complete parity

scope.objective: Non-GUI numerical, data, model, experiment-planning, reproducibility and integration capability parity; CPU implementation remains in scope.
scope.gui: Excluded where purely interactive; static graphics and report artifacts retained as clarification_pending rather than silently removed.
scope.gpu: No GPU-only JMP method was identified in the consulted official catalog. GPU acceleration and GUI are distinct; latest wording is recorded without assuming it removes CPU numerical methods.
scope.separate_products: JMP Live, JMP Clinical, vendor marketplace add-ins distinguished from JMP/JMP Pro built-in methods.
scope.completeness: Every leaf or method-only heading in all 14 capability fragments is represented. Additional selected 19.2 reference subfeatures are expanded. The documentation options tree is broader; this catalog is a traceable lower bound, not a claim to have exhaustively enumerated every undocumented/JSL option.

counting.warning: Aliases across sections merge only obvious identical labels. Some rows are umbrella capabilities; mathematical suboptions require further atomic expansion. Do not convert these unequal-granularity counts into a JMP parity percentage.

status_definitions.absent: No verified implementation for this contract.
status_definitions.partial: A restricted existing kernel or integration exists; official parent capability is not complete.
status_definitions.implemented_verified: Only the expressly bounded listed contract is verified by source, tests and evidence; never implies whole-family parity.
status_definitions.database_existing: DuckDB SQL functionality already supplied by host; not newly implemented extension functionality and needs target-version integration checks.
status_definitions.excluded_gui: Pure GUI interaction excluded by prior user instruction.
status_definitions.clarification_pending: Graph/export scope or conflicting latest wording requires a deliberate scope decision; kept visible.
status_definitions.separate_product: Separate product capability retained for scope transparency.
status_definitions.external_plugin: Listed third-party/marketplace integration, distinct from core platform.

verification_policy.tdd: For every new production behavior: write independent-oracle behavior test, run and record expected RED, implement minimally, record GREEN; refactor and rerun affected suite before SQL/C ABI verification.
verification_policy.promotion: Promote only after actual Rust tests and matching loaded-extension SQL tests with finite JSON, malformed inputs, numerical edge cases, and cross-reference outputs pass. Store commands, revision, platform and artifact hash.
verification_policy.no_name_only_parity: A method name, a thin wrapper, an arbitrary approximation, a passing smoke example, or a patent/copyright-marked product name does not establish mathematical or option parity.
verification_policy.reference: Prefer closed-form fixtures plus independent validated libraries or official reference examples. A direct JMP numerical comparison requires access to JMP and is not claimed here.
verification_policy.new_code_boundary: Current restricted implementations are attached as partial after source/tests/direct-reference inspection and final loaded-extension SQL checks. No official method family is promoted to whole-family parity.

acceptance_contracts.inference: 帰無/対立仮説・片側/両側・有意水準・欠損/重み・小標本/同順位規約を固定し、統計量、自由度、p、効果量と区間を独立参照と照合。
acceptance_contracts.regression: 設計行列/カテゴリ/重み/欠損/切片・リンク・分布を明示。係数、SE、CI、尤度/deviance、自由度、収束/特異性、予測/区間・診断を検証。
acceptance_contracts.doe: 因子型・水準・モデル項・制約・ブロック/全区/部分区、seed、反復・ラン順を明示。実行可能性、ランク、alias、情報行列と効率/検出力を検証。
acceptance_contracts.spc: phase I/II、合理的サブグループ、可変標本数、sigma推定、管理限界・警告ルール規約を固定。既知表と時系列不変条件で検証。
acceptance_contracts.msa: part/operator/replicateの交差/入れ子、固定/ランダム、interaction、欠測/不均衡を明示。分散成分・%study/%tolerance/ndcと区間を参照に照合。
acceptance_contracts.reliability: 右/左/区間打切り・左切断・ties・重みと分布/加速則を固定。尤度、推定量、区間、分位点・hazard/survival/比較検定と極限を検証。
acceptance_contracts.timeseries: 等間隔/欠測・差分/季節周期・定数、推定法・初期値、定常/可逆制約を固定。係数、innovation、尤度、予測区間・holdbackを検証。
acceptance_contracts.multivariate: 前処理を学習データのみでfit。尺度・距離・欠損・重み・成分数選択を明示。符号/回転不定性を考慮した再構成・部分空間・確率を照合。
acceptance_contracts.functional: 横軸grid/単位、irregular sampling、端点、曲線登録・欠損、基底/平滑化/罰則選択、ピーク/背景の規約を固定。解析信号で回復・不変性を検証。
acceptance_contracts.ml: train/validation/test漏洩防止、前処理/seed/hyperparameter・カテゴリ/欠損、重み、early stopを固定。独立参照のloss/予測/確率、再現性、保存再読込を検証。
acceptance_contracts.text: Unicode/tokenization/language/stopwords/normalization・辞書fit範囲を固定。document-term行列・TF-IDF/latent model、未知語・保存再読込を検証。
acceptance_contracts.causal: estimand、識別仮定、overlap、重み/マッチング・caliper、欠測、variance estimatorを固定。既知効果の合成例とoverlap違反・バランス診断を検証。
acceptance_contracts.genomics: marker coding/allele向き、missingness、ploidy・relatedness定義、population correction、型/形式を固定。既知行列・参照ファイルと分散/推論を検証。
acceptance_contracts.data: SQL型/NULL・重複・行順・文字列正規化・カテゴリmetadata、batch/streaming境界を固定。round-tripとschema/数値/行数不変条件を検証。
acceptance_contracts.integration: 対応形式/版・認証・ローカル/ネットワーク・型/NULL/時刻・往復とエラーを契約化。外部製品の独自形式やAPI互換を暗黙に約束しない。
acceptance_contracts.reproducibility: 入力schema/hash、行順、seed、前処理状態、推定設定・バージョン、収束/警告、モデル形式を保存。新プロセス/SQLから再読込し結果を照合。
acceptance_contracts.rendering: GUIイベントと静的出力を分離。採用時は描画元の数値・尺度・単位・対象範囲とartifact形式を固定する。
acceptance_contracts.power: exact/noncentral/近似の選択、効果・分散・alpha・tail・割付比・丸めを明示。達成powerと最小整数n、極限・単調性を独立参照に照合。

features.label: Clustering
implementation: chem_kmeans; deterministic Lloyd iterations
chem_hierarchical_cluster: Euclidean agglomeration with deterministic tie breaks: <=500 feature rows and bounded cubic work; [clusters,linkage0single/1complete/2average/3Ward=2].
chem_dbscan: Euclidean DBSCAN in original feature units: [eps>=0,min_samples>=1 including self]; <=5000 rows and100000000 work units; noise label -1.

chem_gaussian_mixture: Numeric feature rows, >=2 observations, <=32 features. All supplied rows train the model.; [components: required integer 1..min(n,32); maxiter: integer 1..2000, default 200; tolerance: 1e-12..1e-2, default 1e-6; relative observed log-likelihood change; covariance_floor: nonnegative minimum covariance eigenvalue in population-standardized units, default 1e-6; seed: exact integer 0..2^53-1, default 0; SplitMix64 deterministic starts; n_init: integer 1..16, default 1]. Full-covariance Gaussian mixture EM with seeded kmeans++ mean initialization, global initial covariance, exact eigenvalue-constrained covariance M step and log-sum-exp responsibilities. The best observed-likelihood valid start is returned. Component order is lexicographic standardized means. This covariance constraint is not an additive diagonal ridge.

chem_gaussian_mixture_predict: Numeric new feature rows with same width as saved model; 1..10000 rows.; [Unchanged predict_parameters returned by gaussian_mixture; <=16384 finite doubles. Header, scales, weights, symmetry and positive-definite covariance are checked.]. Saved full-covariance component density evaluation with log-sum-exp normalization. No re-centering or refitting on query rows.

chem_self_organizing_map: Numeric feature rows, >=2 observations, <=64 features. All supplied rows train the model.; [grid_rows: required integer 1..32; grid_columns: required integer 1..32, product <=256; maxiter: integer 1..2000, default 100; bandwidth: positive Gaussian kernel bandwidth in normalized [-1,1] grid coordinates, default .5; standardize: 0 none, 1 population feature standard deviation (default); tolerance: 1e-12..1e-2, default 1e-6; maximum codebook displacement relative to previous largest norm]. Rectangular PCA grid initialization spanning +/-2.5 population principal-component SDs. Batch nearest-node assignments are smoothed by cluster-size-weighted Gaussian-kernel local linear regressions on active normalized grid axes. Singular local regression falls back explicitly to local weighted mean, counted in metadata. Bandwidth stays fixed.
remaining_contract: k-means・階層・DBSCAN・全共分散GMM・矩形batch SOMの限定契約を実装。混合の全共分散族/成分選択、SOM全トポロジー/学習規約、その他クラスタ手法・全検証規約は残る。

features.label: Factor analysis
implementation: chem_factor_analysis: Numeric feature rows with >=2 observations and 2..64 variables, or a symmetric positive-definite correlation matrix with diagonal 1.; [factors: required integer 1..variables-1; rotation: 0 none, 1 Kaiser-normalized orthogonal varimax (default); maxiter: integer 1..2000, default 200; each principal-axis and varimax phase has this limit; tolerance: 1e-12..1e-2, default 1e-8; prior: 0 ONE, 1 squared-multiple-correlation SMC (default); input: 0 raw feature rows (default), 1 correlation matrix]. Iterated principal-axis factoring replaces correlation diagonal with communalities and retains largest requested positive common-variance eigenvalues; SMC starts 1-1/diag(R^-1). Varimax uses cyclic analytic pair rotations after row communality normalization. Heywood cases are rejected.

features.label: Scatterplot
remaining_contract: Required CPU artifact: CPU-generated inspectable data plus a human-usable chart/report/document file. Exercise the feature via documented public C ABI and actual loaded-extension DuckDB SQL; numerical JSON alone is insufficient.
Inputs: X/Y observations or summaries, row IDs, optional grouping/color/size/frequency and axes.
Numerical/structured outputs: Transformed point coordinates, row/label/legend correspondence, graphic and optional summary/error output.
Required non-GUI options: Axis transforms, grouping/facets, markers, seeded jitter, hidden/excluded and labels.
Independent acceptance: Independent coordinate transforms and seeded jitter; exact pairwise row exclusion and ID round trip.

features.label: Scatterplot matrix
remaining_contract: Required CPU artifact: CPU-generated inspectable data plus a human-usable chart/report/document file. Exercise the feature via documented public C ABI and actual loaded-extension DuckDB SQL; numerical JSON alone is insufficient.
Inputs: Selected variable columns, grouping/color, row IDs and explicit per-pair missing policy.
Numerical/structured outputs: Ordered bivariate panels and optional global/group density ellipses, labels and static matrix.
Required non-GUI options: Variable order, triangle/matrix format, global/group ellipses and group-specific settings.
Independent acceptance: Independent pair extraction and covariance/eigen ellipses; per-pair missingness and group scale fixtures.
Density/smoother choices require detailed platform options. A correlation matrix alone is insufficient.

features.label: Bar chart

Inputs: Factor/response columns, aggregation, groups/frequencies, category order and style.
Numerical/structured outputs: Summary table and bars/ranges/interval geometry, labels, legend and error endpoints.
Required non-GUI options: Side-by-side/stacked/sorted/nested/range/interval plus other documented styles; response/count summaries.
Independent acceptance: Independent grouped sums/means/counts, stack conservation, signed values and category order.
A single simple bar is partial; the documented style catalogue remains required.
